items.description: A good looking terminal emulator which mimics the old cathode display...
items.editor_note: 把终端变成一台会发光的老电视：扫描线、磷光和 CRT 噪点都可以调到你喜欢的程度。

items.name: Pixelorama
items.description: Unleash your creativity with Pixelorama, a powerful and accessible open-source pixel art multitool. Whether you want to create sprites, tiles, animations, or just express yourself in the language of pixel art, this software will realize your pixel-perfect dreams with a vast toolbox of features. Available on Windows, Linux, macOS and the Web!
items.editor_note: 像素画、精灵、瓦片和动画，一把把旧游戏的视觉零件重新拼起来。

items.name: 86Box
items.description: Emulator of x86-based machines.
items.editor_note: 精确模拟旧 x86 机器，把 BIOS 哔声、软盘和显卡兼容性一起保存下来。

items.name: v86
items.description: x86 PC emulator and x86-to-wasm JIT, running in the browser
items.editor_note: 直接在浏览器里启动一台 x86 电脑。像把整台旧 PC 折成一张网页，再塞进书签。

items.name: dosbox-staging
items.description: DOSBox Staging is a modern continuation of DOSBox with advanced features and current development practices.
items.editor_note: 给 MS-DOS 游戏准备的一间现代化放映室：兼容性更好，但仍然保留那行闪烁的命令提示符。

items.name: chocolate-doom
items.description: Chocolate Doom is a Doom source port that is minimalist and historically accurate.
items.editor_note: 不加滤镜、不追求花哨，只让经典 FPS 按照记忆里的速度和噪声再次启动。
